nodes.text: Next! What'll it be, kid? And before you ask: no, there is no student discount.

options.text: Ask how her day is going
options.message: She talks your ear off for ten minutes about her grandkids. It is weirdly comforting, but your legs are tired from standing in line.
She points her tongs at you. "You think tahini grows on trees? Next!" Everyone in line is staring. You walk away embarrassed.
